title: She calls the doctor sir Peter Teazle
html_source:
Sir Peter Teazle was a character in The School for Scandal, a play by Richard Brinsley Sheridan.

PROPOSED SUGGESTION: Suggestion: Sir Peter Teazle was also the name of a famous British Thoroughbred racehorse from the late 18th century. In the last race of his fourth season, in 1789, he defeated against a mare named Maria. Maria was sired by a horse named Telemachus. Could have to do with all horse allusions? Not sure what to make of this, but I think this connection is significant.
